content.text:
Needed: A wired link to the router, or a switch with a spare port for Home automation server from spare laptop
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "faulty", "for parts", "fiber", "coax", "phone cable", "HDMI"],"pattern": "(ethernet|lan).{0,20}(cable|lead|switch|hub)|cat[-\\s]?[56]e?.{0,10}(cable|switch)","phrasings": [{"text": "ethernet cable","url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=ethernet%20cable","why": "Finds the standard wired link phrasing most sellers use for router to laptop."},{"text": "network cable","url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=network%20cable","why": "Catches sellers who say network instead of ethernet for the same cable."},{"text": "LAN cable","url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=LAN%20cable","why": "Catches short LAN wording and router box contents listings."},{"text": "ethernet switch","url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=ethernet%20switch","why": "Finds small switches that give a spare wired port when router is full."},{"text": "network switch","url": "https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=network%20switch","why": "Catches switch listings worded as network rather than ethernet."}]}
